calls.title: GrowthBook x Rdbrd
calls.summary: The team is preparing for multiple fall events, including a one-day and a two-day conference in September, each targeting distinct audiences like engineers, product managers, and data scientists. Swag selections will vary based on the audience type, with lighter items for practitioners and higher-end items for champions. The focus is on providing practical and valued swag, particularly for engineers. Past items included useful chargers and socks. Shelbe will create a presentation with varied swag options and price points, encouraging team feedback. Collaboration with operations and design teams, led by Lyndsie, will ensure alignment with internal branding. Overall, the plan emphasizes unique swag to stand out at events while managing budgets effectively.
calls.keywords: swag, conferences, employee apparel, holographic stickers, software engineers, AB testing
calls.action_items:
**Shelbe Clester**
Prepare and send a detailed swag presentation including a wide variety of items, pricing, and quantities to GrowthBook by Thursday (05:31)
Contact sticker vendors to explore options for custom holographic stickers similar to samples shared, aligned with product themes like feature flagging and AB testing (07:17)
Follow up with GrowthBook team on employee swag needs after coordinating internally with operations and relevant colleagues (08:24)
Offer to send samples of swag items to GrowthBook upon request, adhering to typical sample value and shipping limits (09:11)
Investigate feasibility and options for custom Legos as high-end swag or customer gifts for select events (10:28)
Maintain timely updates and ongoing communication with GrowthBook regarding swag ideas and progress (11:34)

**Lyndsie Berens**
Coordinate internally with GrowthBook operations colleague and Graham to clarify ideas and requirements for employee swag and apparel before further actions (08:24)
